data.summary: Waitlist API in /workspace/app (Node 24 ESM, `npm start` → node src/server.js on $PORT). On startup it idempotently creates `waitlist(email, paid, paid_at, created_at)` and `stripe_checkout_fulfilments(session_id pk, event_id, status, email_sent, processed_at)`. Endpoints: POST /waitlist (201 {email,position}, 400 invalid, 409 duplicate, sends confirmation email), GET /waitlist/:email (200 {email,position,paid} / 404), POST /skip (Stripe Checkout Session, mode=payment, "Skip the line" USD 500, metadata[email] + client_reference_id, returns {url}), POST /webhooks/stripe (HMAC-SHA256 verification of Stripe-Signature over the RAW body against STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET, 400 on missing/invalid; checkout.session.completed marks the email paid and sends "You skipped the line"). Position is computed with ROW_NUMBER (paid first by paid_at, then unpaid by created_at, 1-based). Exactly-once fulfilment per checkout session is enforced by an atomic claim row, so duplicate/concurrent webhook deliveries and redeliveries after restart never double-send or double-mark. Verified: 28/28 self-written tests (mock Resend/Stripe counting sends and attempts incl. concurrent duplicates, restart idempotency, failing email service), plus smoke tests against the real proxied Neon/Resend/Stripe (real checkout session URL returned, real email sent to a sandbox-accepted address); database, email and payments capabilities were requisitioned via the broker.
